key_insight: Canvas360 improves in-context panoramic generation by pairing geometry-aware pretraining with task-specific fine-tuning. The key idea is that large, high-quality panoramic training data can teach models to handle style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and editing more reliably.
problem_solved: The paper tackles the lack of large-scale, high-quality datasets and training strategies for in-context panoramic generation, where models must preserve 360° geometric consistency while performing diverse editing tasks.
method: Two-stage framework: geometry-aware pretraining followed by downstream task-specific fine-tuning.
Introduces Canvas360Dataset, a 1M-sample paired panoramic dataset covering style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and editing.
Uses high-quality panoramic supervision to improve generalization across multiple in-context generation scenarios.
impact: This work gives practitioners a stronger foundation for building panoramic generation systems that are both more realistic and more controllable. It is especially useful for applications in virtual reality, 360° content editing, and immersive scene synthesis.
visual_elements: Two-stage pipeline diagram showing pretraining and fine-tuning

paper_title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
paper_authors: Haoran Feng, Ruiyang Zhang, Longyi Zhang, Dizhe Zhang, Lu Qi
